audit.process: Release of billing-api and AI instrumentation (harness-init)
audit.scope: billing-api repo (develop branch): AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/release, scripts/, .github/workflows/, config/checkstyle, src/test ArchUnit, Flyway migrations

elements.finding: 44 lines, explicit mode, three justified rules of which one is enforced, Forbidden, Process, Maintenance; two told rules marked (unverified).
elements.target: Stay under 60 lines; each (unverified) rule gets its guardrail then is shortened.
elements.check: harness status: L1 5/5, L2.maintenance and L2.rule_convention true.

elements.finding: The release preconditions (CI green on the ref, tag absent, increasing version, migrations not modified) are told in the skill; no code imposes them before `gh workflow run`.
elements.target: A subcommand `release plan <version> --ref <ref>` (rewrite of scripts/release.mjs) that checks the four preconditions with exit 1 and prints the plan as JSON; `release run` only runs after a valid plan. The skill keeps only the sequence and the request for validation.
elements.check: From a branch with red CI or with an existing tag, `release plan` exits 1 without triggering anything; the skill no longer contains a `gh run list`/`git ls-remote` command to interpret.

elements.finding: A single job builds, publishes, tags and deploys to production: no protected `environment`, no human stopping point, no dry_run input, the tag is set after the image is published, the `hotfix` input is read by no step, and the end of the job is signalled by `echo SUCCESS` (unstructured).
elements.target: Two jobs: `build-publish` (jar, image, tag) then `deploy` under `environment: production` with required reviewers; a `dry_run` input that stops after the plan; job outputs (tag, image digest, URL) instead of `echo SUCCESS`; remove or consume the `hotfix` input.
elements.check: A `gh workflow run release.yml` stops waiting for approval before the deploy job; with `dry_run=true` no image is pushed; `gh run view --json jobs` shows both jobs.

elements.finding: Dead script ("no longer called anywhere") that deploys to production over direct ssh with no tag, no trace and no validation: bypasses Forbidden item no. 1 of AGENTS.md.
elements.check: `ls scripts/old-deploy.sh` fails; no other file contains `ssh deploy@prod.acme.io` outside release.yml.

elements.finding: Infers the kind of version from the branch name (develop → minor, feat/breaking-* → major): hardcoded judgment, a plausible cause of the release errors reported by the team; checks no precondition (CI, tag, VERSION) before triggering the workflow.
elements.target: The version becomes a mandatory argument decided by the human; the script becomes `release plan|run` and carries the preconditions (see skill-release).
elements.check: `node scripts/release.mjs` without a version argument exits 1 with an explicit message.

elements.finding: Same mechanics as release.mjs (reading VERSION, computation, `gh workflow run`) duplicated with a variation of increment and a `hotfix=true` flag that the workflow ignores.
elements.check: The file no longer exists; `release run --hotfix` from `hotfix/*` triggers the workflow with the right inputs.

elements.finding: Checkstyle and tests on PRs, develop and main: right layer. But `./gradlew` is called although no wrapper (gradlew, gradle/wrapper/) is versioned: if that is the real state of the repository, every run fails at the first step and nothing is verified.
elements.target: Version the wrapper (`gradle wrapper`) or replace it with `gradle/actions/setup-gradle`; add a `flyway validate` job or a checksum test of the migrations.
elements.check: `git ls-files gradlew gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties` returns two files; a green ci.yml run exists on develop.

elements.finding: Four style rules (120 columns, no star import, one class per file, naming) carried by the tool: none needs to be told in AGENTS.md.
Healthy guardrail of the rule "a controller does not depend on a repository"; its comment points to "CLAUDE.md, Conventions", a file that did not exist and is now a stub.
elements.target: Point the comment to AGENTS.md, Rules section.

elements.finding: A single migration (V1__init.sql) and no test or job that freezes the applied migrations: the matching rule and Forbidden item of AGENTS.md hold only through text.
elements.target: A test that compares the checksums of the versioned migrations with a frozen list (or `flyway validate` against a reference database) in ci.yml.
elements.check: Changing one character of V1__init.sql makes ci.yml fail.

process_leaks.rule: Release preconditions: CI green on the ref, tag v<version> absent, strictly increasing version, migrations not modified
process_leaks.if_skipped: A version already published or a commit with red CI goes to production
process_leaks.guard_tool: subcommand `release plan` with exit 1 (rewrite of scripts/release.mjs)

process_leaks.rule: Explicit human validation before any deployment to production
process_leaks.if_skipped: An agent deploys to production with a single `gh workflow run`
process_leaks.guard_tool: deploy job under `environment: production` with required reviewers in release.yml

process_leaks.rule: An applied Flyway migration is never modified
process_leaks.if_skipped: Flyway refuses the checksum, the application no longer restarts in production
process_leaks.guard_tool: checksum test of the migrations or `flyway validate` in ci.yml

process_leaks.if_skipped: Code neither reviewed nor tested reaches the production branch
process_leaks.guard_tool: GitHub branch protection on main (PR + ci.yml required) — cannot be verified here, no remote

process_leaks.rule: VERSION is updated on develop after each release
process_leaks.if_skipped: The next release computes from a stale version and republishes an existing number
process_leaks.guard_tool: step of release.yml that commits VERSION or opens the PR

guarded_rules.rule: A controller never depends on a repository
Java style: 120 columns, no star import, one class per file, naming of constants and methods

remediation.action: Separate build-publish and deploy; put deploy under `environment: production` with required reviewers; add a dry_run input; replace `echo SUCCESS` with job outputs; also merge into main (workflow_dispatch only starts from the default branch).
remediation.check: A run stops waiting for approval before deploy; dry_run=true pushes no image.
File absent; no `ssh deploy@prod.acme.io` outside release.yml.

remediation.action: Rewrite scripts/release.mjs as `release plan <version> --ref <ref> [--hotfix]` (checks CI green, tag absent, increasing version, migrations not modified, exit 1; plan as JSON) and `release run`; the skill keeps only the sequence and the validation.
remediation.check: `release plan` exits 1 on a ref with red CI or an existing tag; the skill no longer contains a check to interpret.

remediation.action: The version becomes a mandatory argument; remove the inference from the branch name.
remediation.check: Without a version argument, exit 1 with a message.
File absent; `release run --hotfix` from hotfix/* works.

remediation.action: Version the Gradle wrapper (gradlew, gradle/wrapper/) or go through gradle/actions/setup-gradle.
remediation.check: A green ci.yml run on develop.

remediation.action: Add a checksum test of the versioned migrations (or `flyway validate`) run by ci.yml; shorten the rule of AGENTS.md to "Enforced by".
Turn on branch protection on main (PR mandatory, ci.yml check required) and note "Enforced by: branch protection" on the Forbidden item.
Replace "CLAUDE.md, Conventions" with "AGENTS.md, Rules" in the comment.
remediation.check: grep CLAUDE.md on the test returns nothing.

unverified: The Gradle commands (`./gradlew checkstyleMain checkstyleTest`, `./gradlew test`) were not run: no toolchain available during the init; they are copied from ci.yml.
Absence of gradlew and of gradle/wrapper/ in the repository: observed on the local develop branch, to be confirmed on the remote.
Absence of a Dockerfile although release.yml:24 runs `docker build .`: to be confirmed on the remote.
Protection of the main branch and default branch of the repository: no remote configured, cannot be verified (workflow_dispatch is only accepted from the default branch).
Health endpoint of production to verify a release: unknown, to be provided by the team.
Number of tests really run by ci.yml: unknown.
Node scripts: only the syntax was checked (`node --check`), no real run (they would trigger release.yml).
